findings.problem: Both owners shipped start_readiness.py; Engine runtime precedes App on sys.path. GET starting-preview/playthrough disconnects. The same collision also stops full Web unittest discovery.
findings.fix: App modules renamed start_preview.py and test_start_preview.py; existing HTTP, full Web and browser checks executed.

findings.problem: Engine publishes Henry optional existing-character opening, but App preview rejects every existing-character opening and UI has no matching selector.
findings.acceptance: Select explicit Engine-owned actor-bound opening, review its actual contract, create via UI, commit observation, reload/retry. Henry default remains declaration-only; John cannot borrow Henry or courier circumstances.

findings.problem: Player view omits received start_context, initial civil checkpoint and selected historical elapsed axis; Henry is labelled authored_fiction and prompted to move/deliver a dispatch that he does not possess.
findings.acceptance: Project received civil day without inventing hour/current-calendar binding; show selected elapsed axis; derive scope/prompts from real supported context; retain truthful local state and privacy. Never reseed old saves.

findings.problem: Three full Web tests require historical knowledge to be empty and fail with the legitimate new initial calendar receipt.
findings.acceptance: Assert only the intended received calendar record, provenance/day precision and exclusion of unsourced operational facts; do not delete assertions or reject the received date to make tests pass.

findings.problem: App still pins the prior Engine/Catalog product commits.
findings.acceptance: After adoption, commit exact compatible published Engine/Catalog pins and report clean source selections. A coordinator environment override is candidate evidence, not a pin update.

findings.problem: New requirements and seven baseline diagnostics are valid at historical consumers, but do not qualify Engine schema irgs-start-readiness-1 or Henry existing-person operation.
findings.acceptance: Add a separately versioned selection/consumer for published new Engine and adopted App; preserve original baseline manifests/guards. Qualify explicit modes, Henry source/uncertainty, received day, actual result/elapsed and restart/retry; retain John held, new default/authored and R00 cases.

limits: No unified import or version increase.
No release/package qualification or all-actor/full C2 claim.
No user campaign, live AI or Windows execution.
Catalog skipped consumer/large-reader cases are not relabelled as newly passed.
Runtime operation capture must be regenerated by the coordinator after final source selection.
